single_hypothesis: FP32 wide rows with 8192 < D <= 16384 seed the full-y process tile at 8192 instead of 4096 so the UB budget buys fewer tile rounds rather than more resident y rows; every other dtype/D cell keeps the existing policy.
why_not_duplicate: See 研究/SHAPE-TILING-CHAMPION-X/DEDUP-MATRIX.md. WIDE-X-FRESH4 widened a global tile constant on a weak parent; R31B V016 widened the FP16/BF16 seed on the Champion; R31A uses a separate 7680 CachedRows path; FULL-R029/MODE-X is a five-mode taxonomy that never passed correctness. This change is a shape-banded tile tier on the FP32 mid-wide cell only.
change_summary: Add a D-banded FP32 wide full-y seed tile (8192 for 8192 < D <= 16384, else 4096). No Process* function, reduction, store, dtype or scheduling change.

timing.reason: Correctness gate not passed on the change domain; wide FP32 is nondeterministic in the Direct Parent.
